# CXNM - Standard - AND - U - Corporate Data Protection

Blocks screenshots, file sharing via Bluetooth and factory reset by the user on fully managed and corporate-owned Android devices.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Android |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | UniFy Android Enterprise Baseline v1.5.1 — AND - SC - DR - DEV - General-Settings and Connectivity (Fully-Managed and Corp-Work-Profile) - v1.5 |
| File | [`Baseline_AND_U_Corporate_Data_Protection.json`](Baseline_AND_U_Corporate_Data_Protection.json) |

> Bluetooth headsets, cars and wearables keep working: `bluetoothblocksharing` only blocks file sharing, not pairing. Anyone who needs screenshots for support purposes (e.g. a helpdesk that asks for screenshots) does not assign this policy or creates an exception group. A factory reset via recovery mode remains technically possible; after that, Factory Reset Protection with the administrator account only prevents misuse if `factoryResetDeviceAdministratorEmails` is filled in — that is tenant-specific and is therefore not in this policy. Blocking assistant and AI features is handled separately in Corporate AI Restricted.
